Unique Research · AI Product Traffic Ranking · July 11, 2024

Seven ranking boards for June 2024 — Global Web Top 100, Global App Top 100, China Web Top 100, China App Top 100, China Domestic AI-Native Web Top 50, China Domestic AI-Native App Top 50, and China Company AI Product Traffic Top 50 — plus methodology and definitions. Boards are image-only in the Chinese source; attach on ingest.

Global AI Web Products Top 100

Based on Unique Research’s independent coverage of the AI industry and continuous tracking of nearly 10,000 AI products worldwide, we rank AI Web products by cumulative website visits in the month and publish the global Top 100 by traffic. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: Global AI Web Top 100 — CN source]

Global AI App Products Top 100

On the same research base, we rank AI Apps by cumulative downloads in the month and publish the global Top 100 by downloads. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: Global AI App Top 100 — CN source]

China AI Web Products Top 100

Drawing on Unique Research’s independent coverage and continuous tracking of nearly 1,000 AI products in China, we rank Web products in the China scope — both products by Chinese founders for the domestic market and products by Chinese or Chinese-heritage founders aimed overseas — by cumulative website visits in the month, and publish the Top 100. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: China AI Web Top 100 — CN source]

China AI App Products Top 100

On the same China tracking base, we rank Apps in the China scope (domestic-facing Chinese founders plus overseas-facing Chinese / Chinese-heritage founders) by cumulative downloads in the month, and publish the Top 100. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: China AI App Top 100 — CN source]

China Domestic AI-Native Web Products Top 50

We rank AI-native Web products by Chinese founders aimed at the domestic market only, by cumulative website visits in the month, and publish the Top 50. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: China Domestic AI-Native Web Top 50 — CN source]

China Domestic AI-Native App Products Top 50

We rank AI-native Apps by Chinese founders aimed at the domestic market only, by cumulative downloads in the month, and publish the Top 50. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: China Domestic AI-Native App Top 50 — CN source]

China Company AI Product Traffic Top 50

We aggregate all AI Web and App products under Chinese companies (including companies founded in China or overseas by Chinese nationals or Chinese-heritage entrepreneurs), rank them by combined cumulative visits across those products in the month, and publish the Top 50 companies. The board is in the accompanying chart.

[Image: China Company AI Product Traffic Top 50 — CN source]

Content notice

Data notes

1. Data sources. Traffic figures in this report, article, ranking, or chart are produced by deep integration of diversified mixed data sources, refined with Unique Research’s proprietary algorithms. The set combines broad market observation with technical insight, then undergoes strict labeling, professional classification, and systematic organization by the Unique Research team, aiming to reflect AI product market dynamics and trends as completely and accurately as possible.

2. Coverage scope. The data covers user behavior accessing AI products via websites and apps on computers, tablets, and smartphones. It does not include usage via browser extensions, desktop software, mini-programs, third-party apps such as Discord, or locally run open-source code.

The statistical universe is AI products with more than 10,000 monthly visits. On that filter, analysis focuses on Global Top 30/50/100, China Domestic Top 30/50/100, and Overseas Top 30/50/100 — products with high market activity and a broad user base.

3. How to use the data. Given the complexity and dynamism of collection and processing, and a constantly shifting market, the figures may contain some error or omission. Treat them as a research and analysis reference — not as a definitive basis for specific investment strategies or consulting advice.

When citing data, please credit: Data source: Unique Research (非凡产研). When citing a chart directly: Data source: Unique Research; chart production: Unique Research.

Definitions

1. Geographic dimension

  • Overseas AI products: founded by non-Chinese entrepreneurs or teams, launched primarily for the global market (including but not limited to their home market).
  • China domestic AI products: founded by Chinese-national entrepreneurs or teams, launched primarily for the China market.
  • Overseas (go-global) AI products: founded by Chinese or Chinese-heritage entrepreneurs or teams, with the primary market target set overseas (not the China domestic market).

2. Functional dimension

  • AI-native applications: products designed from the start with AI deeply embedded; core value, business flow, or user experience depends entirely on AI. Without AI, the application would not exist or would lose its core value.
  • AI-feature applications: products that enhance existing functions or add new ones by integrating AI into an established business logic and application frame.
  • AI ecosystem applications: platform-class applications that support, connect, or facilitate exchange among AI R&D teams, application developers, service providers, and end users.

Metric definitions

1. Web metrics

  • Visits: total visit count to a site over a period (e.g. one month). Page views within a continuous active period count as one session; a new visit starts after more than 30 minutes of inactivity, or on a new day.
  • Unique Visitors: number of distinct IPs visiting the target domain in the period. Multiple days of visits by the same person in a month still count as one unique visitor.
  • Visit Duration: average time a user spends on the site in one session over the period — from first to last action in the visit; a visit expires after 30 minutes with no activity.

2. App metrics

  • Downloads: times an app is downloaded in the period (App Store, Google Play, etc.).
  • Sessions: times the app is opened in the period; multiple opens within 5 seconds count as one.
  • Active Users: distinct users who performed at least one activity in the period.
  • Duration Time: total time users spent in the app over the period.

About Unique Research

Unique Research is the new-business innovation and development research center under Unique Capital. It focuses on enterprise-services ecosystems for domestic and go-global companies — new marketing, new retail, new experience — and on combining data technology, AI, and automation with traditional industries such as consumer retail, local services, and healthcare. The analyst team comes from research consultancies, private funds, and tech media.

— END —
